jobs.name: checkpoint_copy_gate
cmd:
import pathlib,subprocess,sys,json
out=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
cmd=['timeout','--signal=TERM','--kill-after=30','1560','python3','/content/chat/upload/checkpoint_copy_gate.py','--upload','/content/chat/upload','--manifest-sha256','f56cfdccf17eb65f0d609b64de1a88783cacd3df9a33e3974ae4581f79f6cc1f','--out',str(out)]
p=subprocess.run(cmd)
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
(out/'transport_exit.json').write_text(json.dumps({'science_returncode':p.returncode,'transport_only':True})+'\n')
sys.exit(0 if all((out/n).is_file() for n in ['gate_summary.json','out.zip']) else 1)

_comment: Model-independent checkpoint boundary only. Expected old CUDA guard failures and fixed full gradients. Transport success permits relay of either scientific outcome, never counts as a numerical pass.
